methodology:
IOI Corporation is one of Malaysia's largest integrated palm oil + oleochemical operators. ~432K acres (~175K hectares) of plantation across Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah, and Indonesia.

IOI's book value includes substantial downstream oleochemical processing infrastructure, not just plantation land. The FMV-vs-book ratio reflects this mixed asset base.
